item.description: Marko's Hot Off The Markets: Double Bottom? GeoMacro Strategy alexios.katina… Wed, 03/04/2026 - 09:22 Strategy Insight 556 03 Mar 2026 Iran Image Clients are universally asking us when we expect President Trump to activate the legendary “Trump Put.” We believe that the S&P 500 would have to correct by more than 10% to practically guarantee a put. We are open minded that it could occur before; it could also occur later. But a double-digit stock price decline will certainly be a greater motivator.
